# Onshape CadScript

Canonical docs: https://ricokahler.github.io/onshape-cadscript/
Repository: https://github.com/ricokahler/onshape-cadscript
SDK package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/onshape-cadscript
Codex plugin package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/onshape-cadscript-codex

Install for Codex:
codex plugin marketplace add ricokahler/onshape-cadscript --sparse .agents/plugins
codex plugin add onshape-cadscript@onshape-cadscript

Model workflow: inspect -> edit model.ts -> preview -> plan -> apply exact plan ID -> render -> measure -> require no-op next plan -> export STL.

Optional persistent MCP: cadscript daemon install --codex -> http://127.0.0.1:27184/mcp. Remove with cadscript daemon uninstall --codex. Full local cleanup: cadscript uninstall.

Safety rules:
- Use one dedicated Part Studio per model.
- Never request an Onshape password, cookie, or API key.
- Never apply without an exact fresh plan ID.
- Treat sketch warnings as errors.
- Inspect rendered image content and measured bounds before STL export.

Primary API: defineModel, length/angle, parameter helpers, sketch AST helpers, typed cad feature/query methods.
Primary MCP tools: cadscript_project_inspect, cadscript_sketch_preview, cadscript_bridge_health, onshape_documents, onshape_project_create, onshape_selection, onshape_partstudio_observe, cadscript_model_plan, cadscript_model_apply, onshape_render, onshape_measure, onshape_export_stl.

Unofficial community project; not affiliated with Onshape or PTC.
